mechanism: Promethazine is a first-generation antihistamine with anticholinergic properties that may increase photosensitivity risk when combined with tazarotene, a retinoid known to cause photosensitivity and skin irritation.
action: Monitor for increased photosensitivity reactions; counsel patient on strict sun protection (SPF 30+, protective clothing) and consider spacing applications or alternative antihistamine if severe dermatologic reactions occur.
